title: Teeth Steroid Extraction for Steroid Profiling in Human Primary Teeth
author: Ruolan S. Wu
materials: Remove all reagents from 4C or -20C and allow to come toroom temp

steps.title: Prepare and Label Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare and label all necessary containers for the assay.

substeps.instruction: Place 5 1.4mm beads in 2mL Bead ruptor tubes and label them.
Label 0.6mL polypropylene microcentrifuge tubes to correspond with bead ruptor tubes.
Label LC-MS/MS vials to correspond with bead ruptor tubes and insert glass inserts into the vials.

steps.title: Prepare Internal Standard
steps.instruction: Prepare a sufficient quantity of 1X I.S. for the assay.

steps.title: Clean and Dry Culture Tubes
steps.instruction: Rinse and dry 12x75mm Fisher culture tubes to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Rinse each tube with 1mL MeOH, vortex for 2 seconds, and discard the MeOH.
Repeat the rinse with another 1mL MeOH, vortex for 2 seconds, and discard.
Place inverted tubes in a tube rack in a drying oven at 60C.
Label the rinsed and dried culture tubes.
Cover the labeled tubes (right-side up) completely with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Process Tooth Samples
steps.instruction: Clean, crush, and weigh the tooth samples.

substeps.instruction: Wash all teeth to remove saliva and blood.
Retrieve cleaned pieces of three teeth from the drawer and record the weight.
Crush each piece into powder using a tooth crusher.
Collect and weigh the resulting powder.

steps.title: Initial Extraction and Lysis
steps.instruction: Combine tooth powder with reagents in bead ruptor tubes.

substeps.instruction: Place tooth powder into the corresponding bead ruptor tubes.
Add 10ul STD to the appropriate bead ruptor tubes.
Add 1mL room temperature HPLC ACN to all tubes.
Add 50ul I.S. to all tubes except the blank (BLKBLK).
Add 50uL of 50% MeOH to the blank (BLKBLK) tube.
Vortex for 2 seconds.

steps.title: Phase Separation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant and perform a hexane wash.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,100g for 5 minutes.
Remove 1000ul of supernatant (94%) and transfer to the 12x75mm culture tubes.
Add 500ul Hexane to all samples.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Centrifuge at 3200g for 2 minutes.
Remove the hexane layer and discard it as waste.

steps.title: Concentration and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the organic phase and resuspend the steroid extract.

substeps.instruction: Dry the ACN at 60C for 45 minutes.
Resuspend the residue in 55ul 25% MeOH.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Centrifuge at 3200g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Final Purification and Storage
steps.instruction: Transfer and concentrate the sample for LC-MS/MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer all supernatant to a 0.6mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 16,100g for 2 minutes.
Transfer 50ul of supernatant to the LC insert using gel loading tips.
Store at -20C until injection.
